Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.entails_iff_sat.type:
forall C D : Constraints.cset,
Constraints.entails C D <->
(forall t : Types.ty, Constraints.sat t C -> Constraints.sat t D)

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.entails_refl.type: forall C : Constraints.cset, Constraints.entails C C

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.entails_trans.type:
forall C D E : Constraints.cset,
Constraints.entails C D ->
Constraints.entails D E -> Constraints.entails C E

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.meet_empty.type:
forall C D : Constraints.cset,
Constraints.meet C D = nil ->
forall t : Types.ty, ~ (Constraints.sat t C /\ Constraints.sat t D)

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.meet_greatest.type:
forall C D E : Constraints.cset,
Constraints.entails (Constraints.meet C D) C /\
Constraints.entails (Constraints.meet C D) D /\
(Constraints.entails E C ->
 Constraints.entails E D ->
 Constraints.entails E (Constraints.meet C D))

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.meet_nodup.type:
forall C D : Constraints.cset,
List.NoDup C -> List.NoDup (Constraints.meet C D)

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.meet_sat.type:
forall (t : Types.ty) (C D : Constraints.cset),
Constraints.sat t (Constraints.meet C D) <->
Constraints.sat t C /\ Constraints.sat t D

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.meet_singleton.type:
forall (C D : Constraints.cset) (t : Types.ty),
Constraints.meet C D = (t :: nil)%list ->
forall u : Types.ty,
Constraints.sat u C -> Constraints.sat u D -> u = t

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.memb_iff.type:
forall (t : Types.ty) (C : Constraints.cset),
Constraints.memb t C = true <-> Constraints.sat t C

Clef.RFC0001.Constraints.sat_decidable.type:
forall (t : Types.ty) (C : Constraints.cset),
{Constraints.sat t C} + {~ Constraints.sat t C}

Clef.RFC0001.Representation.tagged_union.type:
exists decode : Types.tycon * Runtime.bits -> Types.tycon,
  forall (c : Types.tycon) (x : Runtime.atom c),
  decode (c, Runtime.repr c x) = c

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.call_through_entai.type:
forall (C D : Constraints.cset) (G : list Types.oty) 
  (e : TypeCase.tm) (r : Types.oty),
Constraints.entails C D ->
TypeCase.check D G e r = true ->
forall t : Types.ty,
Constraints.sat t C -> TypeCase.well_typed_at t G e r

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.case_free_parametr.type:
forall (e : TypeCase.tm) (t u : Types.ty) (env : list Runtime.val),
TypeCase.case_free e = true ->
TypeCase.seval t env e = TypeCase.seval u env e

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.case_free_uniform.type:
forall e : TypeCase.tm,
TypeCase.case_free e = true ->
exists m : TypeCase.mtm,
  forall t : Types.ty, TypeCase.spec t e = Some m

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.check.type: Constraints.cset -> list Types.oty -> TypeCase.tm -> Types.oty -> bool

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.check_complete.type:
forall (C : Constraints.cset) (G : list Types.oty) 
  (e : TypeCase.tm) (r : Types.oty),
(forall t : Types.ty,
 Constraints.sat t C -> TypeCase.well_typed_at t G e r) ->
TypeCase.check C G e r = true

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.check_narrowing.type:
forall (C D : Constraints.cset) (G : list Types.oty) 
  (e : TypeCase.tm) (r : Types.oty),
Constraints.entails C D ->
TypeCase.check D G e r = true -> TypeCase.check C G e r = true

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.checked_definition.type:
forall (C : Constraints.cset) (G : list Types.oty) 
  (e : TypeCase.tm) (r : Types.oty),
TypeCase.check C G e r = true ->
forall t : Types.ty,
Constraints.sat t C ->
forall env : list Runtime.val,
List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty env (ListDef.map (Types.inst t) G) ->
exists v : Runtime.val,
  TypeCase.seval t env e = Some v /\ Runtime.has_ty v (Types.inst t r)

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.coverage_total.type:
forall (e : TypeCase.tm) (C : Constraints.cset),
TypeCase.covered C e ->
forall t : Types.ty,
Constraints.sat t C ->
exists m : TypeCase.mtm, TypeCase.spec t e = Some m

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.derived_satisfacti.type:
forall (C : Constraints.cset) (G : list Types.oty) 
  (e : TypeCase.tm) (r : Types.oty),
TypeCase.check C G e r = true ->
forall t : Types.ty,
Constraints.sat t C -> TypeCase.well_typed_at t G e r

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.instance_ok.type: list Types.oty -> TypeCase.tm -> Types.oty -> Types.ty -> bool

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.instance_ok_iff.type:
forall (G : list Types.oty) (e : TypeCase.tm) 
  (r : Types.oty) (t : Types.ty),
TypeCase.instance_ok G e r t = true <-> TypeCase.well_typed_at t G e r

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.lookup_typed.type:
forall (env : list Runtime.val) (G : list Types.ty),
List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty env G ->
forall (n : nat) (t : Types.ty),
List.nth_error G n = Some t ->
exists v : Runtime.val,
  List.nth_error env n = Some v /\ Runtime.has_ty v t

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.pick_in.type:
forall (t : Types.ty) (arms : list (Types.ty * TypeCase.tm))
  (a : TypeCase.tm),
TypeCase.pick t arms = Some a -> List.In (t, a) arms

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.seval.type: Types.ty -> list Runtime.val -> TypeCase.tm -> option Runtime.val

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.seval_case.type:
forall (t : Types.ty) (env : list Runtime.val)
  (arms : list (Types.ty * TypeCase.tm)),
TypeCase.seval t env (TypeCase.Case arms) =
match TypeCase.pick t arms with
| Some a => TypeCase.seval t env a
| None => None
end

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.shared_operation.type:
forall (C : Constraints.cset) (o : Witnesses.op) (r : Types.oty),
TypeCase.check C (Types.OVar :: nil)
  (TypeCase.Prim o (TypeCase.Var 0)) r =
true <->
(forall t : Types.ty,
 Constraints.sat t C -> Witnesses.witness o t = Some (Types.inst t r))

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.spec_case.type:
forall (t : Types.ty) (arms : list (Types.ty * TypeCase.tm)),
TypeCase.spec t (TypeCase.Case arms) =
match TypeCase.pick t arms with
| Some a => TypeCase.spec t a
| None => None
end

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.specialization_is_.type:
forall (m : TypeCase.mtm) (G : list Types.ty) 
  (env : list Runtime.val) (t : Types.ty),
List.Forall2 Runtime.has_ty env G ->
TypeCase.mtype G m = Some t ->
exists v : Runtime.val,
  TypeCase.eval env m = Some v /\ Runtime.has_ty v t

Clef.RFC0001.TypeCase.specialization_pre.type:
forall (e : TypeCase.tm) (t : Types.ty) (m : TypeCase.mtm),
TypeCase.spec t e = Some m ->
forall env : list Runtime.val,
TypeCase.seval t env e = TypeCase.eval env m

Runtime.has_ty v a ->
exists w : Runtime.val,
  Witnesses.apply o v = Some w /\ Runtime.has_ty w r
